nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: this Mac port ships `euler`; the original template used `res_multistep`. Scheduler is `simple`. The original author notes `beta` or `normal` can outperform it for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

nodes.title: Sampler / Scheduler
widgets_values:
euler / res_multistep are the two main samplers.

Use Simple scheduler for most things. Beta produces bad audio quality. Normal seems to be good on euler.
If you are not running cu130 (cuda 13.0) you are effectively halving your gen speed using the best version of the model (int8 convrot). Make sure to update!

nodes.title: Prompting Guide
widgets_values:
https://huggingface.co/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3/blob/main/docs/VIDEO_PROMPT_WRITING_GUIDE_ref_en.md

ref2va is EXTREMELY programmatic. Meaning, the instructions you give must be accurate for consistent results. Use the above guide to reference the instructional keywords/tags for use in your own prompts. You can be creative and use natural language for most situations.

Example prompt:
"A cinematic film scene. <Subject 1> is the girl in <Picture 1> and <Picture 2>. Use <Picture 3> as a scene background reference. Use <Audio 1> as <Subject 1>'s dialogue in the video.
[Shot 1] A front view close up of <Subject 1>'s face as she speaks saying the line of dialogue in <Audio 1>, fully_copy: "The muffins are cold now." Her face adopts a sad expression.
[Shot 2] At 00:05, a wide shot in profile view of <Subject 1> lifting the plate of muffins and beginning to walk towards the kitchen as the camera follows her movement.
[Shot 3] At 00:09, a high angle close up from behind showing <Subject 1> in the kitchen opening the oven to put the tray of muffins inside on the oven rack."

Does it have to be as complicated as that? Not really. But according to the prompting guide, the model likes firm instructions like this.

## Model Storage Location

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │   ├── minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors
│   │   └── minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/

│   └── 📂 text_encoders/

```

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)

nodes.title: Spectrum - ON. -27% wall, faces hold. Never enable EasyCache too.

properties.mac_note: Forecasts skipped steps from a fitted curve instead of reusing a cached state, which is why fast-changing detail like a mouth survives. Measured on MPS: 8 of 20 steps forecast, 34:27 vs 47:21 uncached, teeth and lips intact. degree 1 / warmup 1 are the values actually tested here.

Input Text (Prompt)
widgets_values:
If picture 1 was a character ref sheet and audio 1 is a line of dialogue:
A realistic cinematic shot. <Subject 1> is the girl in <Picture 1>. 
A high angle medium shot of <Subject 1> as she leans forward on the balcony facing the camera. The camera pulls in towards a close up of her face. She turns her head side to side looking over her shoulders with a suspicious expression, making sure no one else is around. Afterwards she turns her head back to face the camera, making eye contact with the camera. She speaks the dialogue in <Audio 1> fully_copy: "My muffins are getting cold."

----

If you want to replace a character in video 1 with a character from picture 1:
[video editing] The target video is an edited version of <Video 1>. Replace the girl in <Video 1> with the exact blonde haired girl in <Picture 1>.

---- 

If you want to continue a video:
[video continuation] The target video continues from the last frames of <Video 1>

----

Read the prompt guide below for more!~

nodes.title: APPLE SILICON PORT - READ ME
widgets_values:
## Apple Silicon port

Original by **foxfuressence** - civitai.com/models/2834514. Structure unchanged; only the
platform-incompatible parts are disabled.

**Disabled here (shown bypassed, in purple):**
- `SolAttnPatch` - Sol-Attn needs triton, which has no Apple Silicon build
- `PathchSageAttentionKJ` - SageAttention is CUDA-only
The original also states CUDA 13.0 as a minimum. None of that applies on Mac.

**Changed:** `CLIPLoader` -> `CLIPLoaderGGUF` (Q4_K_M, type `minimax`). The stock NVFP4-AWQ
text encoder is CUDA-only.

**Speed on MPS: both caches ship OFF.** In a seed-controlled A/B, a step cache visibly broke
up mouths and faces; uncached was clean. For b-roll without faces, enable ONE (the original's
own note says never both). Measured at 768x1376/3s against an uncached 20-step reference:
- EasyCache 0.2: -43% wall clock, layout correlation 0.991
- Spectrum: -20%, correlation 0.956

Neither of the CUDA-only speedups is replaced by anything unmeasured; they are simply gone.

**Playback speed fix:** VHS_VideoCombine's frame rate was link-fed 60 (for the RIFE branch).
With RIFE bypassed the frames stay at 24 fps, so renders played 2.5x fast. The link is
severed and the rate pinned to 24. Reconnect it if you wire real RIFE back in.

**Cost is a TOKEN budget, not a resolution or length limit** (tokens ~ megapixels x seconds).
~22k tokens is comfortable — that is 1.03 MP @ 3s (131.6 s/step) or 0.6 MP @ 5s
(137.8 s/step), sampling only, uncached.
1.03 MP @ 5s (~37k tokens) runs but takes ~3x as long and sits near the memory floor.

**Steps: 20.** Below ~6 steps speech breaks before video does. With EasyCache on (b-roll),
15 and 20 steps are indistinguishable because they evaluate a similar number of real steps:
20 skips 9 and evaluates 11, 15 skips 5 and evaluates 10.

**RIFE works on MPS** (measured: `RIFE VFI` with rife47.pth, float32, ensemble on, 8 frames
to 15 in 12s). But the node this workflow ships, `RIFEInterpolation`, is not registered by any
version of the pack on any OS, so it is bypassed here. Wire in `RIFE VFI` instead. If it errors, leave that group bypassed and the rest of
the workflow still runs.

⚠ **This rig needs a SECOND checkpoint.** It ships with the **ref2va** DiT active
(`minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, ~21 GB, same Comfy-Org repo) for the
REF2VA path, with the fl2va one bypassed. That is a separate download from the one the
MacMax workflow uses. Toggle the two UNETLoaders to switch paths.

Required node packs: ComfyUI-GGUF, ComfyUI-AppleSilicon-FP8 (launch with ASFP8_INT8_EXT=1),
rgthree-comfy, ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite, ComfyUI-Easy-Use, ComfyUI-Frame-Interpolation,
ComfyUI-Spectrum-MiniMax-H3, KJNodes.

## CHAINING (Motion Context) + LOW-RAM TEXT ENCODER

**Chain clips (motion + audio continue across the cut).** Needs
[ComfyUI-H3-Motion-Context](https://github.com/NikoDemon80/ComfyUI-H3-Motion-Context).
Every render already SAVES its latent (Save Latent node is active; ~7 MB per clip under
output/h3_context/). To CONTINUE a clip: un-bypass the three purple-parked nodes
(Motion Context, Trim, Load Latent), set Load Latent clip_index to the clip you continue
FROM and Save Latent clip_index to the clip this IS, queue. The continuation comes back
exactly 22 frames shorter (they are the pinned context, trimmed for clean concat).
Validated on a 48GB M5: 5s + 5s join r=0.95, audio bed continues (small level swell).
Resolution must match between chained clips. Do NOT enable Motion Context without a
context latent wired - it refuses by design ("nothing to pin").

**Low-RAM text encoder (optional).** The bypassed ClipProj Loader swaps the 13.6 GB 32B
GGUF encoder for Qwen3-VL-8B fp8 (+240-380 MB projection matrix) ~= 3.7 GB lighter, which
is what makes 5s takes fit on 48 GB. Needs
[ComfyUI-ClipProj](https://github.com/nicolab28/ComfyUI-ClipProj) + matrices from
HF NicoLab28/ClipProj-MiniMax-H3 + the encoder from Comfy-Org/Ideogram-4 repack. To use:
un-bypass it and wire its CLIP output into the clip inputs in place of the GGUF loader.
Measured on-seed A/B vs the GGUF encoder: identity, wardrobe and spoken lines held;
render speed unchanged. Prompt-sensitive edge cases exist (proper nouns) - eyeball outputs.
